evaluation_policy.compute_cost_metric: simulator-instrumented det_us from serial detector-on runs
evaluation_policy.process_wall_times: manifest diagnostics only; excluded from scientific overhead because detector-on performs additional evaluation bookkeeping
evaluation_policy.simfit_role: CLI diagnostic only; excluded from publication plans because no disjoint v4 training provenance is bound
evaluation_policy.trace_sampling: full: all 30 spoof, all 30 replay, 30 benign, and first 5 seeds of each other pure attack (115 deterministic traces); smoke: spoof and benign

clean_fpr_constraint.estimand: P(a benign validation RNG seed has >=1 clean false positive)
clean_fpr_constraint.relation_to_pair_fpr: the seed any-FP indicator upper-bounds that seed's clean-pair FPR, so its population mean is a conservative proxy

frozen_threshold.configured_threshold_summary_recomputati: verified from pair crossing intervals/full-window peaks for every validation run before selection
frozen_threshold.constraint_estimand: P(benign validation run has >=1 clean-pair false positive)
frozen_threshold.prediction_rule: window_peak_score > threshold, applied identically to malicious and non-malicious streams over the evaluation window W = [max(warmup, attack_start + onset_blank), sim_time]; pairs with no reception inside W are excluded from every arm
frozen_threshold.reported_clean_fpr_estimand: per-clean-pair false-positive rate within attack runs
frozen_threshold.selection_rule: maximize macro F1 across RNG-seed blocks subject to the exact one-sided seed-level upper confidence bound on P(a benign validation seed has any clean false positive); ties choose lower upper bound, lower empirical FPR, then higher threshold
